pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark regions with predominantly smooth edge gradients; spatial area of patches increases from the lower flank toward the mid-body and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light pathways forming a continuous topological network; junction nodes typically exhibit three-way intersections; pathway thickness is generally uniform throughout the visible region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder region against the background.
